basis: Source-confirmed design reproduction against actual modules plus the retained actual-module test that currently expects stale post-reset and post-retention grant reuse.
defects: Capabilities have no per-grant identity or durable revocation state; same-profile devices can receive indistinguishable authority.
DO detach returns fresh anonymous authority without revoking the presented grant or its sockets.
Reset, retention and internal erasure delete the state/fence, allowing an old anonymous credential to recreate the object and restart linking.
Completed-link retry mints a fresh recognized credential, so revoking only a returned token would be bypassable.
Heartbeat and push paths do not revalidate durable authority; deferred ODP receipt push is outside the object serialization boundary.
